GN.name: Contribution des patentes (fixed duty by turnover class + 15 % of rental value)
GN.statute: CGI (loi L/2021/032/AN) art. 289, 296, 300 bis; LF 2025 (L/2024/0235/CNT) and LFR 2024 do not amend them; LF 2022-2024 not held
GN.doc: art. 300 bis: 1st class (turnover of the previous year at least 10 bn GNF) fixed duty 10 000 000; 2nd (5-10 bn) 5 000 000; 3rd (3-5 bn) 3 000 000; 4th (800 M-3 bn) 2 000 000; proportional duty 15 % of the rental value (art. 296: highest of the lease, comparison and 10 % of the market value), never below a third of the fixed duty (art. 296-IV).
unsupported: industrial establishments 5 % and extraction / convention companies 10 % (art. 300 bis III-IV)

turnover below 800 M: the printed 5th class reads 'turnover below 1 000 000 000 GNF: outside the patente', inconsistent with the 4th class floor of 800 M (layout loss in the official PDF): no charge modelled below 800 M

BF.name: Contribution des patentes (tableau A fixed duty by turnover + 8 % of rental value)
BF.statute: CGI édition officielle 2023 (à jour LF 2023) art. 237, 239 (loi n° 042-2018/AN art. 34), 240-241; LF 2024 and LFR 2024 do not amend them; LF 2025 not held
BF.doc: art. 239 tableau A (general case), previous year's turnover excluding tax: up to 5 M 10 000 F; 5-7 M 15 000; 7-10 M 25 000; 10-15 M 40 000; 15-20 M 60 000; 20-30 M 85 000; 30-50 M 125 000; 50-75 M 175 000; 75-100 M 250 000; 100-150 M 325 000; 150-200 M 400 000; above 200 M add 100 000 F per 100 M or fraction; art. 241: proportional duty 8 % of the rental value, never below a fifth of the fixed duty.
unsupported: tableaux B (liberal professions), C (beverage wholesalers, filling stations, airtime dealers) and D (transporters)

TG.name: Patente (rate of the turnover bracket on the whole turnover; commerce column)
TG.statute: CGI 2025 (OTR, CGI et LPF 2025) Livre II art. 250, 252, 254
TG.doc: art. 254: the patente is the rate of the bracket of the year's turnover excluding tax applied to that turnover (whole amount, not marginal); commerce / hotels / pharmacies column: 0,55 % up to 500 M, 0,60 % from 500 000 001 to 10 bn, 0,65 % from 10 000 000 001 to 50 bn, 0,70 % above 50 bn.
unsupported: other sector columns: services/insurance/banks/BTP (0,75-1,20 %), telephony/IT (0,80-1,20 %), industries (0,70-1,00 %), used vehicles (0,85-1,00 %)
regulated-margin products taxed on the margin, 60 % reduction for pagne-cloth resellers (art. 254)
taxe professionnelle unique for small taxpayers (art. 129 ff.)

CF.name: Contribution des patentes (rate of the turnover class on the whole turnover)
CF.statute: CGI 2017 mis à jour 2023 art. 189; LF 2025, LFR 2024-2025 and LF 2026 as held contain no patente amendment (budget pages only partly OCR'd)
CF.doc: art. 189: the patente is a rate on the previous year's declared turnover, by class: 4th class 30-100 M 1,00 %; 3rd class 100 000 001 to 1 bn 0,60 %; 2nd class 1 000 000 001 to 10 bn 0,45 %; 1st class above 10 bn 0,20 % (rate of the class on the whole turnover).
unsupported: turnover below 30 M (outside the classes of art. 189)
assessment at ten times the purchases when no accounts (art. 190)

TD.name: Contribution des patentes (droit déterminé 0,1 % of turnover N-2, centimes CNPS/CCC/RAV, ONASA, TVLP 10 %)
TD.statute: CGI 2016 art. 790 I, III, IV; LF 2023 and LF 2025 (and the DGI circular on LF 2024) do not amend it; LF 2017-2022 not held
TD.doc: art. 790: droit déterminé 0,1 % of the turnover excluding tax of year N-2, the base capped at 2 bn with a tenth of the excess added (abatement of 9/10ths); centimes on the droit déterminé: CNPS 10 %, CCC 7 %, RAV 3 %; ONASA 480 F flat; TVLP 10 % of the annual professional rental value.
unsupported: communal increase of the tariff by council deliberation within the limit set annually (art. 790 II)
transporters' fixed and variable duties (art. 790 V-VIII)

MR.name: Patente (general tariff by the previous year's turnover)
MR.statute: CGI version officielle janvier 2023 art. 187-188 (art. 188 nouveau LFI 2021); LF 2025 held only in Arabic, not checked
